name: A&D HOLON Holdings Co Ltd
summary: A&D HOLON Holdings Company Limited, founded in 1977 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, specializes in delivering a broad spectrum of measurement and analysis technologies. Its extensive product catalog encompasses sophisticated systems for measurement, control, and simulation, alongside analytical instruments such as FFT, sound, and vibration analyzers. The company also manufactures digital ultrasonic devices for detecting flaws and measuring thickness, as well as machinery for material testing, and A/D D/A converters crucial for semiconductor fabrication. Moreover, A&D HOLON provides a wide array of weighing equipment, including precision electronic balances, digital platform scales, industrial weighing systems, indicators, controllers, and advanced data processing systems for both weighing and general measurement. For the medical and home health markets, their offerings include digital blood pressure monitors for clinical and personal use, a variety of scales designed for healthcare settings, consumer digital scales, and ultrasonic nebulizers. The company's precision technologies further extend to photomask CD-SEM and defect review SEM products, along with specialized tools for roller mold measurement.
